The stage sides are right and the captions match them: Jayce owns levels 1 to 5 on cannon poke, and Level 6 is Skill because Glacial Prison reaches 1300 while Shock Blast casts from 600. First and second item stay listed as his even though the captions lean Sejuani; I did not re-side them because both win-rate sources for this matchup agree it stays near even, so the sides are defensible as written.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields call Sejuani's passive 'your Permafrost passive armor' or 'Permafrost passive resistances'. Permafrost is her E, a 560-range point-and-click stun on a 1.5s cooldown. The armour and magic resist come from Fury of the North (P), which Riot describes as granting Frost Armor 'and immunity to slows'. That slow-immunity clause appears nowhere on the page, and it directly answers To the Skies!, Jayce's only slow.
audit.why: Two separate costs. Naming the passive after the E teaches the wrong ability, exactly the class of error in this project's calibration list. And missing the slow immunity means the page never tells a Sejuani that his hammer-stance leap slow does nothing to her walk-up while Frost Armor holds — the one fact that makes closing the gap on him possible.
audit.corrected: Fury of the North and Frost Armor are now named correctly in whys[0], spikes[0], early and mid, and the slow immunity against To the Skies! is stated in early and wants.you[0].

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[0] says 'Jayce's Shock Blast is on a 6-second cooldown' at level 1. mid tells you to walk back in when he burns Thundering Blow but never says how long that window lasts.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6 across six ranks, so 6 seconds is its rank-6 value and 16 is what it actually is at level 1. Understating it by ten seconds turns a genuinely punishable poke into an unpunishable one. Thundering Blow is 20 seconds at rank 1 down to 10 — that is the real length of the window mid gestures at.
audit.corrected: 16s at rank 1 now in whys[0] and spikes[0]; Thundering Blow's 20s stated in whys[2] and mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing mentioned that Jayce's stance swap is an auto-attack reset that shreds resistances.
audit.why: Riot's Mercury Cannon text: the first attack in cannon form 'reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist'. Against a champion whose entire plan is stacking resistances, that first post-swap auto is the tell, and it is an auto reset on a 6-second stance cooldown.

edits.after: Neither of you threatens much at level 1 — Shock Blast is 16 seconds at rank 1, not six, so one miss buys a long free window, and Frost Armor absorbs the first hit. Last-hit behind your wave.

edits.before: Jayce's level-1 cannon poke is real but gated behind a short cooldown, so stand behind your minion wave and let him waste Shock Blast on minions rather than burning your passive armor on free damage. At level 2 he starts mixing Acceleration Gate with Shock Blast for the long-range accelerated shot that strips your Permafrost passive resistances from range before you can close — the moment you see the Gate placed, back off the wave for five seconds rather than eat the projectile. Your level-3 full combo of Arctic Assault into Winter's Wrath into Permafrost is the first real threat you pose, but Jayce can stance-swap to hammer and use Thundering Blow to knock you clear of melee range the instant you land; save your Q as a gap-closer only when you have a Frost stack already built from W, giving Permafrost the instant stun to prevent the knockback escaping.
edits.after: Jayce's level-1 cannon poke is real but Shock Blast is 16 seconds at rank 1, so stand behind your minion wave and let him spend it on minions rather than on your Frost Armor. At level 2 he starts mixing Acceleration Gate with Shock Blast for the accelerated long-range shot that strips your resistances before you can close — the moment you see the Gate placed, back off the wave for five seconds rather than eat the projectile. Your level-3 combo of Arctic Assault into Winter's Wrath into Permafrost is the first real threat you pose. Two things make it work. Fury of the North grants immunity to slows while Frost Armor holds, so his hammer-stance To the Skies! leap-slow does not stop your walk-up. And Thundering Blow, 20 seconds at rank 1, is his only way to shove you off — so build a Frost stack with W before you spend Q, letting Permafrost stun instantly and deny him the knockback escape.

edits.before: Levels 4 through 5 are Jayce's clearest window — his cooldowns are short enough to cycle accelerated pokes repeatedly, and your damage doesn't scale fast enough to threaten him in an equal-HP duel, so accept the CS deficit and absorb with Second Wind rather than trading into his rotation. At level 6 the lane flips in terms of threat: Glacial Prison's range means you can open with R before he can stance-swap to cannon for a safe distance, and the blizzard zone prevents him from walking out of range even if the first stun misses him. From 6 onward, every time he burns his Thundering Blow knockback to push you away from a trade, that is your cooldown window to walk back in and force the fight he cannot win in melee range with your passive armor stacked.
edits.after: Levels 4 through 5 are Jayce's clearest window — his cooldowns cycle accelerated pokes faster than your damage scales, so accept the CS deficit and absorb with Second Wind rather than trading into his rotation. At level 6 the threat flips: Glacial Prison reaches 1300 where Shock Blast casts from 600, so you can open with R before he stance-swaps to a safe distance, and the blizzard zone stops him walking out even when the bola misses. From 6 onward the rule is simple arithmetic. Thundering Blow is 20 seconds at rank 1 and only 10 at rank 6, so every time he spends the knockback to shove you out of a trade, that is exactly how long you have to walk back in and force the melee fight he cannot win with your Frost Armor stacked.

edits.before: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — Gate-accelerated poke — stand behind minions and close after it whiffs. Check it before every step-up. - Q dash is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Jayce Shock Blast: matchup-defining — 16s at rank 1 falling to 6s at rank 6. Fights start on its downtime, not yours. - Thundering Blow is 20s at rank 1: once he spends the knockback, walk straight back in. - Frost Armor makes you slow-immune.
